int_name: W ROOSEVELT BLVD & W WYOMING AVE

result.summary: This signalized intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to navigate traffic without designated protection or timing. The wide roadway increases exposure time, while the absence of visible curb ramps or refuge islands further degrades the walking environment.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: There are no visible pedestrian signal heads, meaning walkers must guess when it is safe to cross based on vehicle lights.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information and crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed divided arterial roadway that is entirely hostile to pedestrians. There are no sidewalks, crosswalks, or pedestrian signals, leaving any non-motorized users completely exposed to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: The complete absence of sidewalks or paved paths forces pedestrians to walk in the grass or on the unpaved shoulder immediately adjacent to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: High-Speed Multi-Lane Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane design with a large median encourages high vehicle speeds without any physical protection or separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians separated from the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and ADA-compliant curb ramps to allow for safe crossing of the multi-lane arterial.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks. The environment is characterized by high-speed vehicle lanes and significant sun glare, which creates a hazardous condition by reducing visibility for all road users.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Intense direct sunlight creates significant glare, potentially blinding drivers and making it difficult to see pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant amount of time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: This intersection is designed primarily for motor vehicles, with wide lanes and a lack of basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks or signals. While crosswalks are marked, they terminate in grass, and the long crossing distances increase exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: No paved walkways exist, forcing pedestrians onto grass or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the road edges where the crosswalks terminate

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires a long time to cross, increasing exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway crossing the field of view

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals for pedestrians are visible, making it difficult to know when to cross safely.
hazards.location_in_image: On the utility and signal poles at the intersection

interventions.description: Install continuous paved sidewalks to connect the intersection to surrounding areas.

interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signals.
